name: Brutalist Acid 酸性粗野主义
description: 超大文字、酸性撞色、粗黑边与硬投影
taboos: 不要把每页都做成海报
coverStructure: single dominant statement with an offset visual counterpoint
sectionStructure: hard chapter breaks with a short provocation
titleTreatment: oversized black title with one acid word
decorativeLanguage: bold borders, cutout blocks and one hard shadow
bodyCompositionBias: asymmetric text-to-evidence scale; let one object dominate

density.guidance: 保持中等信息量，让主判断、证据和行动层级拉开

tocStructure: stacked index slabs with oversized numerals and one acid highlight
heroStructure: one huge statement block with a hard shadow and a single counterweight shape
